title: Cognition launches new SWE-2 model, Rivaling Fable 5.1 and GPT-Astra
summary: Cognition has released SWE-2, a new software engineering model that reportedly competes with Fable 5.1 and GPT-Astra. The announcement, shared via a blog post and discussed on Hacker News with 426 points and 176 comments, highlights ongoing competition among AI coding assistants and agentic developer tools.
